question: How many tracks are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track;

question: List the top 5 best-selling albums by total revenue
gold_sql: SELECT a.Title, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album a ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId, a.Title ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which genre has the most tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show customers from Brazil with their total spending
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS customer, SUM(i.Total) AS spent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Brazil' GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY spent DESC;

question: Average track duration per genre in minutes
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, AVG(t.Milliseconds)/1000.0/60 AS avg_minutes FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY avg_minutes DESC;

question: How many distinct artists have at least 5 albums?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT ArtistId FROM Album GROUP BY ArtistId HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5);

question: Employees who handle more than 10 customers
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS n FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId HAVING n > 10;

question: Top 3 countries by invoice total
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Tracks longer than the average track in their genre
gold_sql: SELECT t.Name FROM Track t WHERE t.Milliseconds > (SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) FROM Track t2 WHERE t2.GenreId = t.GenreId);

question: Most popular playlist by number of tracks
gold_sql: SELECT p.Name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Median invoice total
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM (SELECT Total FROM Invoice ORDER BY Total LIMIT 2 - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice) % 2 OFFSET (SELECT (COUNT(*) - 1) / 2 FROM Invoice));

question: Customers who bought every genre
gold_sql: SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT g.GenreId FROM Genre g WHERE NOT EXISTS  (SELECT 1 FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId=i.InvoiceId   JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId=il.TrackId   WHERE i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId AND t.GenreId = g.GenreId));

question: Year-over-year revenue growth
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year, SUM(Total) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

question: Albums where every track is longer than 5 minutes
gold_sql: SELECT a.Title FROM Album a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Track t WHERE t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId AND t.Milliseconds <= 300000);

question: Customers who haven't purchased anything
gold_sql: SELECT c.CustomerId FROM Customer c LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceId IS NULL;

question: Top 5 best-selling tracks of all time
gold_sql: SELECT t.Name, SUM(il.Quantity) AS sold FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY t.TrackId ORDER BY sold DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Artists with revenue above average artist revenue
gold_sql: WITH artist_rev AS (SELECT ar.ArtistId, SUM(il.UnitPrice*il.Quantity) AS rev FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId=il.TrackId JOIN Album a ON a.AlbumId=t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId=a.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId) SELECT ar.Name, rev FROM artist_rev JOIN Artist ar USING (ArtistId) WHERE rev > (SELECT AVG(rev) FROM artist_rev) ORDER BY rev DESC;

question: Number of tracks composed by 'AC/DC'
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Composer LIKE '%AC/DC%';

question: Customers grouped by spending tier (low <50, mid 50-200, high >200)
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN total < 50 THEN 'low' WHEN total < 200 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'high' END AS tier, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId) GROUP BY tier;

question: Average tracks per playlist
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(n) FROM (SELECT PlaylistId, COUNT(*) AS n FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY PlaylistId);
